reviews.text: Used Mearns Caine lodge many times for both my dogs. Staff are always friendly, accommodating and great with our nervous dogs. Couldn't ask for a better team to look after your pup while away
Nice open space for the dogs to run, clean kennels, easy booking process, friendly staff
Read the website and it says day care rate, then Monday - Friday kennel rate. You think that’s okay try and book and then they hit you with a night rate. Absolute cash grab
Picked up my aunts dog Stanley. Lovely staff and my aunt always raves about this place!

A really well-run daycare with a genuinely caring team. The staff are attentive, patient and clearly understand dog behaviour, which is so reassuring. Dogs are cared for thoughtfully and always come home settled and happy.

I honestly have no words for how amazing this place is. I’ve got two little chihuahuas who couldn’t be more different – one is super friendly and the other is very cautious and anxious. They hadn’t been boarded for six years, so it was suggested we try a couple of trial nights first. This was such a great idea and really gave Hugo and Ralph the chance to settle in.
The staff are just incredible. Susan has spent so much time and patience with Hugo, helping him to feel comfortable, and it honestly means the world to us. You can truly see how much they care for your pets and do everything they can to make them feel safe and at ease. I wouldn’t take them anywhere else.

Absolutely fantastic dog boarding! The only place I've ever put my dog into and managed to get him back in the same, happy condition. The photo updates they post on Facebook are great for seeing your pet when you are on holiday. Would definitely recommend and use again.

this place is absouletly amazing! the staff are very friendly and helpful! my spaniel came back after her trial night before a longer stay and she was really happy and had taken straight to the team. not to mention she came back tired and you know how hard it is to tire a spaniel!  I'm so happy I went with this team for watching my pup while I'm away, I have no concerns and can't wait to see all her little adventures while she's away! I don't think i could have chosen a better place ❣️

Our lab collie X has just come home following  boarding with the team at mearns canine Lodge.   He had an amazing time. Lots of running  around in the secure run to ensure he was never bored.  Plenty photos and video updates.    Lots of walks around the estate too.  He's a very young rescue dog with a fabulous nature   only with us for 6 months,  so there was apprehension around leaving him.
We definitely had nothing to worry about.  The team took great care of him and he was very relaxed when we picked him up today as well as being exhausted.   I will definitely be using these guys again.  Thank you to Dianne, Alan and all the team at MCL  xxxxxxxxxx
Dog grooming very good and professional well experienced. Bear loved it would recommend happy dog.

Can't recommend Mearns Canine Lodge highly enough. Staff are brilliant, facilities are excellent, it's so good my dog Murphy trotted back in like he was staying again have never seen him so relaxed and happy in a kennel before. Don't get me wrong there was nothing wrong with the other places he has been, but he loved this place, gave me so much peace of mind knowing how well he was looked after, and the pics and videos on Facebook were excellent!

My dog has been staying at Mearns Lodge for 8 years, usually once a month, and loves it! The team are so welcoming and take special care of his extra needs as a senior dog. I feel so reassured knowing how well he’s being looked after (and spoiled!)
Great kennels, good space and plenty of exercise, friendly caring staff too
Fantastic caring day care and boarding . Staff are excellent
